data.gender_notes: Sharvansheem is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharva is the name of Lord Shiva, the king of gods in Hindu mythology. Ansh is a Sanskrit term meaning 'king'. Together, Sharvansheem means 'King of the Gods'. The name Sharvansheem carries the meaning “King of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvansheem usually hope their child will grow to embody king of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine grace and power of Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism.
data.etymology: Sharvansheem belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvansheem total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sharvansheem holds a significant cultural impact in Hindu traditions as it is associated with Lord Shiva, one of the primary deities worshipped in Hinduism. Lord Shiva is revered as the god of destruction, transformation, and regeneration. He is often depicted as the eternal Prakriti Purush or the embodiment of pure Shiva consciousness. The name Sharvansheem pays homage to this powerful deity, signifying respect and devotion towards him and the profound influence of Hindu mythology on Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sharvansheem holds immense spiritual significance for Hindus as it symbolizes the idea of surrendering oneself to the divine will of Lord Shiva. Just as the king has absolute power and jurisdiction over his subjects, Lord Shiva is believed to be the absolute ruler of all creation. By invoking the name Sharvansheem, one seeks Lord Shiva's blessings, protection, and guidance in life's journey. The name is a constant reminder of the existence of a higher power and the importance of spirituality in human life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sharvansheem: Descendants of Lord Sharva, embodiment of purity and devotion to the divine. Their souls are immersed in the river of eternal bliss and knowledge.

historical_references.reference: The Sharvansheem dynasty ruled the ancient Indian kingdom of Magadha from the 6th century BCE to the 4th century BCE.

trends: The name Sharvansheem is not commonly used in modern times.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Sharvansheem remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
